Header.value: 1. Choose who is speaking (keys 1-6), then drag on the waveform over one turn. Overlapping speakers get separate regions.
2. Click the region and type exactly what was said, fillers included. Hindi words in Devanagari, English words in Roman: आज हम photosynthesis पढ़ेंगे, umm, हाँ, अच्छा.
3. Numbers as spoken, in words. Can't make it out after two listens: [inaudible].
4. Never type a student's name: write [student]. Other private people: [name]. Phone, ID numbers, email, address: [phone] [id] [email] [address].
5. Silence: mark gaps of 2 seconds or more where nobody speaks. Leave its text empty.
